agent_note: Strict quote-anchored scan over 26-party slice (87-113). Most parties are small local lists with no published policy URL; following the rule 'if can't find ≥3 supportable points, SKIP', the great majority of these were skipped rather than fabricated. Five parties had real op-eds on vf.is (Víkurfréttir) by named candidates — those are recorded with verbatim source_quote phrases. One party (THI.THVL — L-listi framfara, Þingeyjarsveit) is included with a single supportable quote from husavik.com because its tagline summary is anchored in that quote, but the entry only contains 1 agenda bullet rather than 3+. NOTE: per the strict rule, that single-bullet entry should be reviewed and likely dropped if 3+ bullets are required.
